description: Refactoring de Qualidade de Código — eliminar duplicação, reduzir acoplamento e clarificar responsabilidades sem alterar nenhum contrato público de API ou comportamento observável.

userStories.title: Criar constants.ts com MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH e remover duplicatas
userStories.description: As a developer, I want MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH declared in exactly one place so that the three AI pipeline files stop redefining the same constant.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `packages/ai-pipelines/src/constants.ts` exporting `MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH = 8000`
`summarize.ts`, `rewrite.ts` and `create-prd.ts` each import MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH from `./constants` instead of declaring it locally
No remaining `MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH` declaration exists in `summarize.ts`, `rewrite.ts` or `create-prd.ts`
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: constants.ts criado; imports atualizados nos 3 arquivos; typecheck passou.

userStories.title: Criar base-pipeline.ts com função runPipeline
userStories.description: As a developer, I want a shared runPipeline function that handles stages 1, 2, 4 and 5 common to all AI pipelines so that each pipeline only needs to implement stage 3 (prompt building).
acceptanceCriteria: Create `packages/ai-pipelines/src/base-pipeline.ts` exporting `runPipeline(input, buildPromptFn)`

`runPipeline` contains: stage 1 (empty content validation), stage 2 (truncation using MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH from constants.ts), stage 4 (model invocation via withTimeout + withRetry), stage 5 (log + trace completion)
`runPipeline` accepts `buildPromptFn: (truncatedInput: string) => string` as second parameter for stage 3
File compiles without errors; no existing pipeline file is modified in this story
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: base-pipeline.ts criado com runPipeline(input, buildPromptFn, pipelineName, emptyContentError); typecheck passou.

userStories.title: Extrair use-case executeCommand de commandsRoute
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the orchestration logic of POST /api/commands/run extracted into a dedicated use-case function so that commandsRoute only validates the request, creates the runId and delegates.
acceptanceCriteria: Create `apps/api/src/use-cases/execute-command.ts` exporting `executeCommand(payload, runId, workspaceRoot): Promise<void>`
`executeCommand` contains: file reading, pipeline selection, pipeline execution, SSE event emission and error handling
`executeCommand` uses early returns for pipeline-not-found and file-not-found failures, with a single final catch block
`apps/api/src/routes/commands.ts` POST handler body contains no file-reading or pipeline-execution logic; it only creates the run record and calls `void executeCommand(...)`
Typecheck passes
Tests pass
userStories.notes: executeCommand extraído para use-cases/execute-command.ts; commandsRoute é lean; typecheck e 22 testes passaram.
